name: Eszter Kovács
bio:
Eszter Kovács's career path took an unexpected turn into motorsport after years in corporate HR. Initially working for a large multinational, she felt detached from the tangible impact of her work. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, she jumped at the opportunity to join Hot Car Competições five years ago, seeing it as a chance to blend her professional skills with her passion.

Eszter is known for her pragmatic and results-oriented approach. She believes in fostering a supportive yet competitive environment where talent can thrive. Her focus is on streamlining HR processes to ensure the team can concentrate on performance, and recruiting the best talent to drive the team forward. 

What sets Eszter apart is her ability to identify potential in unconventional places. She actively seeks out individuals with the right attitude and aptitude, even if they lack direct motorsport experience, believing that passion and adaptability are crucial for success.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves and a side parting.
physical.description: Eszter has a warm and intelligent face with a confident smile and a no-nonsense posture.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized desk, with color-coded files.
Drinks copious amounts of strong, black coffee throughout the day.
Starts every meeting with a quick, humorous anecdote to lighten the mood.
